# Ethnicaa Wholesale

> India's leading B2B marketplace for wholesale Kurtis, Sarees, and Salwar Suits direct from Surat manufacturers.

## Key Information
- **Domain**: https://ethnicaa.com
- **Target Audience**: Resellers, Retailers, and Boutique owners worldwide.
- **Niche**: Ethnic wear, Wholesale textile market, Surat manufacturing.
- **Contact**: support@ethnicaa.com | WhatsApp: +91 9586346332
- **Location**: Surat, Gujarat, India.

## Navigation & Discovery
- **Catalogs**: https://ethnicaa.com/category/all
- **Sarees**: https://ethnicaa.com/category/sarees
- **Kurtis**: https://ethnicaa.com/category/kurtis
- **Pakistani Suits**: https://ethnicaa.com/category/pakistani-suits
- **Brands**: https://ethnicaa.com/brands
- **Wholesale Blog**: https://ethnicaa.com/blog

## Business Model
Ethnicaa provides direct factory-to-reseller access. All products are sourced directly from the Surat textile market. We support international shipping to 50+ countries including USA, UK, Canada, and UAE.

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js (App Router)
- Data powered by Firebase Firestore
- Image optimization enabled for fast global delivery.
